note: Reported symptom is an access violation compiling a hs_6_6 hull shader whose only 'use' of two module-scope globals (a float3x3 with arithmetic init, and a static Texture2D<float4>[ARRAY_SIZE]) is that they exist and are never referenced by any function. Per SKILL.md step 4, use internal_failure keyed on exit status, not message text: the maintainer comment and the reporter's own table of ARRAY_SIZE values (0/2 'ok', 1 AV at 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, >2 AV at 0x0) both describe a crash whose printed text is not guaranteed to be stable across builds/sizes, and a Debug ground truth may trap an assert (0x80000003/0xE0000001) where a Release build access-violates (0xC0000005) for the same underlying defect -- is_internal_failure() covers both without keying on wording. CONTROL: control-no-globals.hlsl removes both unused globals (everything else byte-identical) and must compile cleanly (--expect no-match); control-spirv.hlsl uses the identical shader targeted with -spirv, which the maintainer says does not trigger the crash (--expect no-match), corroborating that this is DXIL-lowering-specific (SROA per the comment) rather than a front-end problem.
